The repository's [Grounding curriculum](/learn/mindfulness/grounding.html) focuses on immediate sensory information, the body, and the current environment. It does not prescribe a numbered sensory count, so this tool does not invent one.

Grounding can create room to notice the present before choosing a next step. You can pause or stop if a prompt is uncomfortable. Afterward, note in your own words whether it helped you orient; an immediate mood change is not required.
